name: Esmo Asia Pte. Ltd.
india_angle: Esmo Asia Pte. Ltd. provides testing solutions for leading semiconductor players in India, including Infineon, TI, and TATA OSAT.
summary: Esmo Asia Pte. Ltd. specializes in manufacturing semiconductor equipment, particularly handlers, manipulators, and docking/interfacing solutions. They serve major semiconductor companies worldwide, offering high-end, reliable test equipment developed and designed in Germany.
